hide-plan-card.description: Available promotional placements are hidden; absent placements are untested.
Cloud queue, usage limit, disk/connection errors and billing controls stay visible.
All five promo placements and copy variants hide against matching shipped markup, including late insertion.

hide-header-actions.description: Thread header on desktop and phone: no Report a bug button and no Share button; other header actions and plugin actions keep their spacing.
A thread with an active share link still shows the Shared button and its popover can stop sharing.

file-link-menu.description: Right-click an absolute file link in a chat: Reveal in Finder is the first row; for .html/.htm files Open in Browser follows; then a separator and the native rows, which still work.
Reveal in Finder closes the menu and opens Finder on edm-node with the file selected; a missing file returns 404 without an error dialog.
Open in Browser opens the HTML page with its relative CSS/images via a file-preview lease: the default browser from the desktop app, a new Safari tab when viewing remotely; no login or 401 page.
Thread, sidebar and other context menus get no extra rows; disabling the plugin removes them.

thread-ids.description: Sidebar dropdown/right-click/phone long-press copy the selected row ID, not the open chat or name; keyboard selection, closing, failure feedback, remounts and cleanup work.
All three copy commands appear in the palette for an open thread.
Copy ID, mention and link from a known thread; verify values without exposing preexisting clipboard contents.

mobile-fixes.description: Plugins and Skills remain available on phone and desktop according to native sidebar preferences; mobile-fixes does not hide them.
Open Environment picker on a real phone and verify home-indicator clearance without doubled padding.

iPhone thread: swipe left from the right edge drags the page and reveals the right panel; past a third or a flick opens it, short slow swipes snap back; vertical scroll and taps on header buttons unaffected; swipe right still closes.
Phone thread: no floating Side chat button under the header; message Side chat action still opens the right panel; desktop still shows the header button.
iPhone thread: focus the input; its box sits on the keyboard toolbar with no extra 8px band; after dismissing the keyboard the normal spacing returns.

Phone new-thread screen: Recent list scrolls from just under the header to the input; a short list rests on the input; no empty band under the No project/Cloud row; Connect Claude footer still shows when disconnected.

keep-spinners.description: While mounted, adding data-window-blurred to the root is cleared; disposal stops observing.
In the desktop app, a real running spinner keeps animating while the window is unfocused.

sidebar-status.description: Unread dot and attention glyphs are visible under actual theme variables, light and dark.
No threads and All threads pinned hide/dim; Threads unavailable stays visible and undimmed, including in-place text changes.
Idle/complete/unknown progress, stale ages, cloud and active states, hover actions and remounts behave correctly.
Project expand/collapse and guide lines work at 100%/110%, including reduced motion and rapid toggles.

ui-scale.description: At desktop width and browser zoom 100%, root size is 110% with no horizontal/full-height overflow.
At phone width with a coarse pointer, the plugin leaves the base size alone; inspect layout and picker alignment.

server-identity.description: Exactly the existing Connect button is marked with backend hostname, expected dot color and hover text; no extra row.
Connect errors remain visible; server dot moves clear of alert badge; click and cleanup still work.
On the other independent server, identity comes from that backend, not the viewing device.
On edm-node the enabled send button is blue with a white arrow; disabled stays grey; edm-mbp keeps the default.
On edm-node, tap the mic: the recording bar's send button (phone) or check button (desktop) is blue, stays blue with a spinner while transcribing; cancel and stop buttons keep their default look.

compact-navigation.description: Visible native actions share one row when they fit; extra destinations wrap; no overflow.
Native actions, More/Search, full-size Customize, modifier/split behavior and long-press context menus work.
Hover/focus tooltips and accessible names work without duplication; touch targets fit.
Route/remount/text updates work; disposal removes owned spans, attributes, observer and CSS.

thread-menu-keys.description: P/U/R/A/C/S/Delete activate the displayed native action for that menu thread; toggles, confirmations, dropdown/right-click/compact drawer and copy-ID integration work.

No activation outside a root thread menu, in inputs/submenus/other dialogs, on disabled/ambiguous actions, modifiers, composition or repeats; native navigation/typeahead remains available for other keys.
Visible hints do not duplicate accessible names; aria-keyshortcuts, cached menus, label updates, remounts and cleanup work in both themes.
